snippet.title: Deadzone: Rogue - Official Zone 4: Apophis Content Update Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Zone 4: Apophis Content Update Release Date Trailer for Deadzone: Rogue, a sci-fi first-person roguelike developed by Prophecy Games. Players will soon gain access to an extensive content update packed with all-new enemies, bosses, missions, progression systems, and more. The Zone 4: Apophis Content Update for Deadzone: Rogue is launching on December 17 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), alongside a new Mark 2 pack DLC and a free-to-play access period starting on December 17.
